activity.notes: Kwame Nkrumah served as Prime Minister of independent Ghana from independence on 6 March 1957 until the republican constitution came into force on 1 July 1960, when the prime-ministerial system was replaced by an executive presidency.

sources.title: Application of Ghana for Admission to Membership in the United Nations — United Nations General Assembly A/3566
sources.citation_text: Ghana's 6 March 1957 UN membership application is signed by Kwame Nkrumah as Prime Minister and Minister responsible for External Affairs of Ghana.

sources.title: Constitution of the Republic of Ghana, 1960 — GhaLII
sources.citation_text: The 1960 Constitution commenced on 1 July 1960 and established the President as Ghana's head of state and executive authority, appointing Kwame Nkrumah as first President.
